dish.title: Bhindi Masala: Crisp-Edged Spiced Okra with Homemade Chapati
dish.description: Okra cut into coins and seared in a wide skillet until browned at the edges and not slimy, then tossed with onion, tomato, cumin, and warm spices. Served with soft whole-wheat chapatis cooked on a dry skillet.

recipe_version.title: Bhindi Masala: Crisp-Edged Spiced Okra with Homemade Chapati
recipe_version.description: Okra cut into coins and seared in a wide skillet until browned at the edges and not slimy, then tossed with onion, tomato, cumin, and warm spices. Served with soft whole-wheat chapatis cooked on a dry skillet.

ingredients.name: fresh okra
ingredients.preparation: rinsed, dried completely, trimmed, cut into 1/2-inch coins

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: 2 tbsp okra, 1 tbsp masala, 1 tbsp dough

steps.title: Make the dough
steps.body: In a mixing bowl stir the 2 cups whole-wheat flour with 1/2 tsp salt and 1 tbsp oil. Add 3/4 cup warm water a little at a time, mixing to a soft dough. Knead 5 minutes until smooth, cover with a damp towel, and set aside.

steps.title: Prep the okra and aromatics
steps.body: Rinse the okra and dry it completely on towels (dry okra stays crisp-edged). Trim the stems and cut into 1/2-inch coins. Slice the onion, chop the tomatoes and chile, mince the garlic, grate the ginger, chop the cilantro, and juice the lemon. The dough rests meanwhile.

steps.title: Sear the okra
steps.body: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high. Add the okra in a single layer and cook uncovered, stirring every 2 or 3 minutes, until browned at the edges and no longer sticky, about 12 minutes. Transfer to a plate.

steps.title: Build the masala
steps.body: Lower the heat to medium and add 1 tbsp oil to the skillet. Add the cumin seeds for a few seconds, then the onion, and cook until soft and lightly golden, about 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger, and chile for 1 minute, then the turmeric, coriander, and chili powder. Add the tomatoes and cook until they break down, about 3 minutes. Return the okra with 1 1/4 tsp salt and toss 2 minutes. Stir in the garam masala and lemon juice and cover off the heat.

steps.title: Cook the chapatis
steps.body: Heat a dry 10-inch cast-iron skillet over medium-high. Divide the dough into 8 balls and roll each into a thin 7-inch round, dusting with the extra flour. Cook one at a time, about 1 minute per side, until blistered with light brown spots, pressing the edges with a folded towel so the round puffs. Stack in a towel to keep soft.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Spoon the okra onto plates, scatter the cilantro, and serve with the warm chapatis.
